description: This file contains an implementation of the FundWritePlatformService interface using JPA repository for persistence. It provides methods for creating and updating Fund entities, with transaction management, caching, and data integrity handling.

classes.name: FundWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of FundWritePlatformService interface, providing methods to create and update Fund entities with proper exception handling, transaction management, and caching.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Creates a new fund entity from a JsonCommand, handling data integrity issues and returning a command processing result with the new fund's ID.

methods.name: updateFund
methods.description: Updates an existing fund identified by fundId using data from a JsonCommand, handling exceptions and returning a result with changes.

methods.name: handleFundDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Private method to handle specific data integrity violations, throwing precise exceptions based on the cause message.
